result.edit: Make the Moore outputs combinational (always @(*)) driven by the current state so they reflect the newly-entered state on the same clock edge, and remove the self-holding nstate latch by returning to the current state on no-coin conditions (S0_5/S1_5 state stays are explicit). This resolves the off-by-one where outputs lagged one cycle (amount=3 with sel=0 wrongly showed 000 instead of 100).
